verdict.rationale: No evidence describes composing reusable sub-workflows or modules that other workflows can call — Pipedream's docs cover triggers, actions, code steps, CLI, Connect/MCP, and error handling, but nothing about a 'call another workflow' or shared reusable module/sub-workflow feature is mentioned in the evidence pack. missing for 10: documentation of a sub-workflow/child-workflow invocation mechanism, reusable module import/reference across workflows, any example of one workflow triggering or embedding another as a component.
